hypothesis: Price all unfinished work over a common horizon and fixed MW clearance, rather than only original tagged jobs or batch counts.
horizon_rule: H=t0+2*tau_max for every registered state and root; no horizon sweep.
candidate_score: Integral from t0 to H of all waiting plus admitted-unfinished jobs, plus remaining completion-time sum under fixed MW with no arrivals after H.
continuation: Same finite parent with complete consumed-anchor after-tree; consume every later native dispatch including idle until common H; keep committed jobs and lane release times in terminal state.
common_randomness: Retain original8 planning paths and their globally indexed native Poisson background streams, with fixed anchor rates; add no samples and no future true tape to chooser.
terminal_rule: Fixed native MaxWeight, original catalogue/FIFO/lane release and idle polling semantics; no births after H. Count waiting and in-flight work exactly once, including actions crossing H.
past_cost: Any elapsed visible/inflight flow before t0 is root-independent; omit only as an explicit common constant in S1 comparisons.
score_replacement: Replace old full tagged S1; do not add overlapping cost to it. Preserve original BG risk set and feasibility constraint.
overflow: Keep all registered samples and costs; unavailable if an environmental cap prevents full fixed-horizon/terminal score, never drop or resample.
evaluation_order: First compare fixed3 states x2 roots x8 paths with separate common-horizon and terminal cost contributions. Any policy promotion subsequently needs original full development protocol and mean/tail checks.
implementation_fix: Read native planning events time and coordinate by index; retain original three-field paths, eight samples, cap128 and H2tau.
